title: Boston Gas Company files for approval by the Department of Telecommunications & Energy a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Massachusetts Port Authority.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. Commissioners participating in the decision were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners Paul B. Vasington, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (CG 00-29)
